sentences.text:
12-12-2024 Heard Mr. M. R. Khandakar, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. K. K. Parasar,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam.

2. Apprehending their arrest, the petitioners, namely, (1) Manash Kumar Seal and (2) Mihir Kumar Seal, both sons of Manik Chandra Seal, resident of Village-Khalilpur, P.S.-Dhubri, District-Dhubri have filed this application under Section 482 BNSS, 2023 seeking pre-arrest bail in Dhubri P.S. Case No. 253/2024 corresponding to G.R. No. 833/2024 registered under Sections 498(A)/420/376/511/34 IPC, read with Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. List this matter on 04.02.2025 enabling the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam to place the up-to-date case diary pertaining to said Dhubri P.S. Case No. 253/2024.
4.

Till then, (i.e., 04.02.2025), it is provided that, in the event of arrest of the petitioners, namely, (1)
Manash Kumar Seal and (2) Mihir Kumar Seal, in said Dhubri P.S. Case No. 253/2024, they shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/- each, with two local sureties each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting authority on conditions that the petitioners - (i) shall appear before the Investigating Officer of said Dhubri P.S. Case No. 253/2024 on or before 19.12.2024 and thereafter, as and when they are required for necessary investigation of said Dhubri P.S. Case; (ii) shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction of the Dhubri Police Station, without obtaining prior written permission from the concerned Investigating Officer of the case;
Page No.# 3/3 (iii) shall not hamper with the investigation, or tamper with the evidence of the case; (iv) shall not,
directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer and (v) they shall not involve themselves in any criminal activities in future.
5. Any violation of the aforesaid terms and conditions by the petitioners, named above, the interim pre-arrest bail granted to them in said Dhubri P.S. Case No. 253/2024 shall stand automatically vacated.
6. List accordingly.
JUDGE
